disassembly.description: Inspect disassembled code starting from the supplied address. If the address belongs to a recognized internal function, the complete containing function is returned. If no containing function is recognized, a configurable forward code region is returned instead. The result includes the requested address, the resolved function when available, and readable instruction lines formatted as hexadecimal address followed by instruction.

address.description: Internal code address, for example 0x401000, 4427076, or fcn.00401000.

callers.description: Return callers of one internal code address.

address.description: Internal code address, for example 0x401000, 4427076, or fcn.00401000.

callees.description: Return callees of one internal code address.

address.description: Internal code address, for example 0x401000, 4427076, or fcn.00401000.

inspect_section.description: Inspect one binary section and return a bounded overview of its metadata, counts, and previews.

list_imports.description: List available imports compactly. Use this for discovery when available APIs are unknown or enrichment is weak.

list_functions.description: List recognized internal functions compactly without disassembly. Use this for discovery when internal code candidates are needed.

list_sections.description: List binary sections compactly with address, size, and permissions. Use this for discovery when binary layout is needed.

list_entrypoints.description: List recognized entrypoints compactly. Use this for discovery when additional execution starts are needed.
